title: Tim Taylor disappears after 15 years of contact
summary: Charles Hall's wife tells of Tim Taylor disappears after 15 years of contact, about c. 2000s-2020s at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He just disappeared. We never heard from him since.

plain: The wife of Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret Air Force base in Nevada, speaks of a man named Tim Taylor who had been in touch with the couple for about fifteen years. She says that one day he simply disappeared, and they have never heard from him since.
